about: A function reads only its parameters (chapter 4 § 4.7.4). The function draft_section drafts from the parameter draft, when it has text. Invalid: its node patient_draft's if reads the input consult_draft. Valid: the parameter draft.
sentences: Node 'patient_draft' in function 'draft_section' reads input.consult_draft; a function reads only its parameters: add a parameter and pass it in with.
